crossRefs.note: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
Therefore Saul said to Yahweh, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people…
Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.
Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both…
The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in…
The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.”…
They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

translations.web: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;
translations.bsb: Now this is what we will do to Gibeah: We will go against it as the lot dictates.
